# Ibyungura.com

> A Rwandan real estate marketplace where verified agents list houses, apartments, land, commercial property and vehicles for sale or rent.

Visitors browse listings for free, filter by city, price, category and bedrooms, and contact agents directly by phone or WhatsApp. Agents register for an account, publish listings, and can upgrade to paid tiers for higher listing quotas, analytics and a verified badge.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured and latest property listings across every category.
- [All properties](/properties): Full searchable listing directory with city, price, type and bedroom filters.
- [Find an agent](/agents): Directory of verified property agents with profiles and achievements.
- [Property guides](/rwanda): Curated entry points for common searches (houses for sale in Kigali, land in Rwanda, cars, commercial space).
- [Houses for sale in Kigali](/rwanda/houses-for-sale-in-kigali): Active Kigali sale listings with RWF prices.
- [Houses for rent in Kigali](/rwanda/houses-for-rent-in-kigali): Available Kigali rental houses.
- [Land for sale in Rwanda](/rwanda/land-for-sale-in-rwanda): Plots with size in square metres.
- [Cars for sale in Rwanda](/rwanda/cars-for-sale-in-rwanda): Vehicles listed by agents and dealers.
- [Become an agent](/register): Create a free agent account to publish listings.

## Optional

- [Agent log in](/login): Sign-in page for existing agents.
